title: Was It You? Reconnect
short_description: Reconnect with people you crossed paths with. City stories, map notes, messages.
full_description:
Was It You? Reconnect (SenMiydin? in Turkey) is a social app for the small moments of city life that never got finished: a hello on the beach, a glance on the tram, a journey you still think about. Share the moment, find the person you crossed paths with, and turn it into a story together.

Reconnect with people you crossed paths with
Tag the person you met with @username. When they accept, the encounter is confirmed by both of you. A shared story is only published with a separate approval from both sides.

Your city’s stories
Browse memories, thoughts, confessions, encounters and journey posts from your city, and keep a separate feed for the people you follow. Comment, reply, like and save posts to your private collections.

Map Notes and My Letters
Leave a digital letter at an approximate spot on the map. It stays for 7 days, can be public or anonymous, and others can answer it. Manage your active and archived letters in My Letters, and get a small notification when someone leaves a note near you.

People nearby
See people around you by approximate distance or area, only if you choose to turn location on. You can always pick your city by hand instead.

Messages
The first message is a request. Once it is accepted, chat one-to-one with photos, voice messages, emoji, free gifts and approximate-location messages. There is no live location sharing.

Share outside the app
Turn a public post, encounter or Map Note into a card for your story or feed. Anonymous posts never show who wrote them, and Map Notes never show an exact location.

Privacy and safety
Your exact location is never shown to other users. Places I Passed is optional and off by default. The app is for ages 16 and over: accounts aged 16–17 only meet their own age group, and accounts aged 18 and over only meet adults. Blocking, reporting and account deletion are built in. This is not a dating app and it offers no live tracking of people or vehicles.

Ads
Small native ads labelled “Ad” may appear in the feed. Your location is never used for ad targeting, and accounts aged 16–17 never see personalized ads.

You can use the app without location permission by choosing your city by hand. It does not promise to find a specific person.
release_notes: First test release: city stories, encounters, Map Notes, messages with photos, voice and free gifts, shareable cards, and Turkish and English support.
